tagline: Reprise — the language player that splits audio into sentences
defaultDescription: Reprise is an audio player for shadowing and repeating that splits audio into sentences so you can replay one sentence at a time.
appCard: A focused app for repeating one sentence at a time. Core practice is free, with no account needed. For iPhone · iOS 26 or later
guidesTitle: Practice guides — how to do shadowing and repeating
guidesDescription: How to do shadowing, repeating, overlapping and dictation, and how to practice with your own audio: podcasts, lesson recordings and the audio that comes with textbooks.
guidesLead: How to practice speaking out loud, and how to turn your own audio into study material in Reprise.
